title: School WiFi Login Page
scenario: A new WiFi page near school asks for your student login but the name looks slightly wrong.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: School WiFi Login Page: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Use only official network names confirmed by school staff.
